--- title: "05b — Lineage-resolved function" author: "Hu Lab" date: last-modified format: html: toc: true toc-depth: 2 code-fold: show df-print: paged --- # Contents While prior script asks which taxa and which KOs belong to each habitat, **separately**. 05b does a combo every **class-level taxon × KO pair** gets a habitat class, and the pair table feeds three questions. 06 and 07 read the pair table and the 05 habitat classes. Presence/absence only: a pair is detected or it is not. 1. **Lineage repertoire.** For each taxonomic lineage, _how many of its KOs are vent-only, vent-skewed, shared, non-vent-skewed or non-vent-only?_ Trying to figure out if we have vent-specific signatures 2. **Lineage functional profile.** Each taxonomic lineage's functional profile split across KEGG level-B categories, per habitat, against the habitat average. (what a taxa does, and whether that changes between habitats) 3. **Same function, same lineage?** For KOs expressed in both vent and non-vent, do the same lineages express them? (Jaccard index of the taxon sets in each habitat.) _Are vent-specific KOs expressed by vent-specific taxa or by taxa that are present everywhere?_ **Rules** (`config/params.yml`, shared with 05, 06 and 07): * *Detected* in a unit: ≥ 1 scaledTPM and ≥ 10 per million of the unit's retained expression. For a taxon × KO pair, "retained expression" is still the whole unit's, so a pair has to clear the same bar as a whole KO. * *Pair habitat class*: the 05 occupancy rule applied to the pair (associated with a habitat when detected in ≥ 3 of its units: ≥ 3 of 13 vent units, ≥ 3 of 6 non-vent units). Vent-only = vent-associated and never detected in background water; plume detections are allowed (decision 2026-11-23). * *Taxon expressing a KO in a habitat* (3): a pair detected in ≥ `pair_min_units` (2) units **of that habitat**. One rule in `config/params.yml`, used here and in 06. 2 of 13 is a lower bar than 2 of 6, so section 3 reports the result at 1, 2 and 3 units. * Pairs are only built for pairs detected in at least one unit. A pair never detected cannot be in any habitat class other than `below_filter`, so nothing is lost. **Depth.** Vent libraries are about 5.6-fold shallower than non-vent units. A taxon with a large share will have more pairs clear the per-million floor, so repertoire size follows expression share. Section 1 prints that correlation; read repertoire *fractions*, not counts, across lineages. # Set up ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} source(if (file.exists("_setup.R")) "_setup.R" else "scripts/_setup.R") ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} FIELDS_IN_SCOPE <- c("Gorda Ridge", "Von Damm", "Piccard") CHOSEN_DEPTH <- 4 MIN_TPM <- params$detect_min_tpm MIN_PER_MILLION <- params$detect_min_per_million MIN_UNITS <- c(vent = params$vent_min_units, nonvent = params$nonvent_min_units) # 3, 3 VENTONLY_TOLERATED <- params$ventonly_tolerated_tokens # "Plume" PAIR_MIN_UNITS <- params$pair_min_units MIN_REPERTOIRE <- 50 # lineages with fewer associated KOs are left off the repertoire figure MIN_PROFILE_SHARE <- 0.005 # lineages need >= 0.5% mean share in a habitat to get a profile HABITAT_TABLE <- "output-tables/05_ko_habitat_class.csv" # from 05 TAXON_TABLE <- "output-tables/05_taxon_habitat.csv" # from 05 habitat_pal <- c(Vent = "#b74a70", `Non-vent` = "#346D6E") class_levels <- c("vent_only", "vent_skewed", "shared", "nonvent_skewed", "nonvent_only") class_pal <- c(vent_only = "#7A1F45", vent_skewed = "#D98AA8", shared = "grey75", nonvent_skewed = "#7FB3B4", nonvent_only = "#1F5556") class_lab <- c(vent_only = "Vent-only", vent_skewed = "Vent-skewed", shared = "Shared", nonvent_skewed = "Non-vent-skewed", nonvent_only = "Non-vent-only") ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # built at the end of 02 (R/load_paired.R) paired <- load_paired(fields = FIELDS_IN_SCOPE, depth = CHOSEN_DEPTH) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` [load_paired] data/processed/paired_L4.RData (built 2026-11-08 11:40; 324,868 rows) ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} units <- paired |> distinct(unit = sample_unit, vent_bin, field, n_reps) |> arrange(vent_bin, field, unit) stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(units$unit), sum(units$vent_bin == "Vent") == 13, sum(units$vent_bin != "Vent") == 6) tax_key <- paired |> distinct(cur_group, cur_supergroup, cur_phylum, cur_L4, resolved_L4) |> mutate(taxon = taxon_label_unique(cur_L4)) stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(tax_key$cur_L4)) ko_hab <- read_csv(HABITAT_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) tax_hab <- read_csv(TAXON_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) vent_kos <- ko_hab |> filter(habitat_class %in% c("vent_only", "vent_skewed", "shared")) |> pull(ko_id) nonvent_kos <- ko_hab |> filter(habitat_class %in% c("shared", "nonvent_skewed", "nonvent_only")) |> pull(ko_id) message(glue("{length(vent_kos)} vent-associated and {length(nonvent_kos)} non-vent-associated KOs (05)")) #make sure most recent build is available. ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` 1255 vent-associated and 3212 non-vent-associated KOs (05) ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} brite_map <- read_brite_level_b() ``` ::: # 1. Taxon × KO × habitat One row per class-level taxon × KO pair, with the 05 occupancy rule. This is the table every later section reads. Pools replicates, get total for each unique sample, get transcript (or feature) total. > share = tpm / sample total > per_million = share x 1^6 ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pair_ue <- unit_expression(paired, c("cur_L4", "ko_id"), min_tpm = MIN_TPM, min_per_million = MIN_PER_MILLION) #span helpers # changes transcript TPM counts so that each row is a "biological unit" or feature. pair_keep <- pair_ue |> filter(detected) |> distinct(cur_L4, ko_id) pair_ue <- pair_ue |> semi_join(pair_keep, by = c("cur_L4", "ko_id")) message(glue("{nrow(pair_keep)} taxon x KO pairs detected in at least one unit")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` 31115 taxon x KO pairs detected in at least one unit ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} pair_hab <- habitat_occupancy(pair_ue, units, c("cur_L4", "ko_id"), MIN_UNITS, VENTONLY_TOLERATED) pair_tpm <- pair_ue |> summarise(pair_tpm = sum(tpm), .by = c(cur_L4, ko_id, vent_bin)) |> pivot_wider(names_from = vent_bin, values_from = pair_tpm, values_fill = 0) |> rename(tpm_vent = Vent, tpm_nonvent = `Non-vent`) pair_all <- pair_hab |> left_join(pair_tpm, by = c("cur_L4", "ko_id")) |> left_join(tax_key, by = "cur_L4") |> left_join(ko_hab |> select(ko_id, ko_habitat = habitat_class), by = "ko_id") |> left_join(tax_hab |> select(cur_L4, taxon_habitat = habitat_class), by = "cur_L4") # stopifnot(!anyNA(pair_all$taxon), max(pair_all$n_det_vent) <= 13, max(pair_all$n_det_nonvent) <= 6) pairs_assoc <- pair_all |> filter(habitat_class != "below_filter") pairs_assoc |> count(habitat_class) |> mutate(frac = round(n / sum(n), 3)) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # MIN_TPM # 1 # MIN_PER_MILLION #10 ``` ::: > Detected: tpm >= min_tpm & per_million >= min_per_million ## Repertoire of each lineage For every lineage, the pairs it carries by pair class. Fractions are of that lineage's habitat-associated KOs. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} repertoire <- pairs_assoc |> summarise(n_ko = n(), vent_only = sum(habitat_class == "vent_only"), vent_skewed = sum(habitat_class == "vent_skewed"), shared = sum(habitat_class == "shared"), nonvent_skewed = sum(habitat_class == "nonvent_skewed"), nonvent_only = sum(habitat_class == "nonvent_only"), .by = cur_L4) |> mutate(across(all_of(class_levels), \(x) x / n_ko, .names = "frac_{.col}")) |> left_join(tax_key, by = "cur_L4") |> left_join(tax_hab |> select(cur_L4, taxon_habitat = habitat_class, occ_vent, occ_nonvent, mean_share_vent, mean_share_nonvent), by = "cur_L4") |> arrange(cur_supergroup, desc(n_ko)) repertoire |> select(taxon, cur_group, taxon_habitat, n_ko, starts_with("frac_")) |> mutate(across(starts_with("frac_"), \(x) round(x, 2))) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # does repertoire size just follow expression share? repertoire |> mutate(n_ko_vent = vent_only + vent_skewed + shared, n_ko_nonvent = shared + nonvent_skewed + nonvent_only) |> summarise(rho_vent = cor(n_ko_vent[n_ko_vent > 0], mean_share_vent[n_ko_vent > 0], method = "spearman"), rho_nonvent = cor(n_ko_nonvent[n_ko_nonvent > 0], mean_share_nonvent[n_ko_nonvent > 0], method = "spearman")) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: Can't get away from depth-related issues across library types. This is a test for how a taxonomic TPM size may just followTo how many samples it appears in. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # >SKH: 2026-11-13 plot code moved into plot_repertoire() so the companion figure below is identical plot_repertoire <- function(rep) { rep_long <- rep |> select(cur_group, taxon, n_ko, all_of(class_levels)) |> pivot_longer(all_of(class_levels), names_to = "pair_class", values_to = "n") |> mutate(pair_class = factor(pair_class, levels = class_levels), frac = n / n_ko, taxon = fct_reorder(taxon, n_ko)) ggplot(rep_long, aes(frac, taxon, fill = pair_class)) + geom_col(width = 0.8) + geom_text(data = distinct(rep_long, cur_group, taxon, n_ko), aes(x = 1.01, y = taxon, label = n_ko), inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = 2.4) + scale_fill_manual(values = class_pal, labels = class_lab, name = NULL) + scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) + facet_grid(cur_group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") + labs(x = "Share of the lineage's habitat-associated KOs", y = NULL) + theme_minimal(base_size = 9) + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), legend.position = "top", strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, face = "bold", color = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"), axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black")) } fig_repertoire <- plot_repertoire(repertoire |> filter(n_ko >= MIN_REPERTOIRE)) fig_repertoire # ggsave("figures/05b-repertoire.svg", fig_repertoire, width = 6, height = 9) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](05b-lineage-profiles_files/figure-html/fig-repertoire-1.png){#fig-repertoire width=576} ::: ::: A taxon-by-KO pair is habitat-associated when detected in at least 3 of that habitat's units (3 of 13 vent, 3 of 6 non-vent); vent-only pairs are never detected in background water (plume detections allowed). > Distribution category for KOs in each taxonomic lineage. Bars report class-level taxa with at least 50 habitat-associated KOs (number on right side axis), colors show the distribution of vent-only, vent-skewed, shared, non-vent-skewed or non-vent-only. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # >SKH: 2026-11-13 companion figure: lineages below MIN_REPERTOIRE that still carry # vent-associated lineage-resolved KOs (vent-only + vent-skewed >= MIN_VENT_SIGNAL) MIN_VENT_SIGNAL <- 5 repertoire_low <- repertoire |> filter(n_ko < MIN_REPERTOIRE, vent_only + vent_skewed >= MIN_VENT_SIGNAL) message(glue("{nrow(repertoire_low)} lineages below {MIN_REPERTOIRE} KOs with ", ">= {MIN_VENT_SIGNAL} vent-associated KOs")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` 8 lineages below 50 KOs with >= 5 vent-associated KOs ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} repertoire_low |> select(taxon, cur_group, n_ko, vent_only, vent_skewed, shared) |> arrange(desc(vent_only + vent_skewed)) ``` ::: {#fig-repertoire-low-1 .cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} fig_repertoire_low <- plot_repertoire(repertoire_low) fig_repertoire_low # ggsave("figures/05b-repertoire-low.svg", fig_repertoire_low, width = 6, height = 5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](05b-lineage-profiles_files/figure-html/fig-repertoire-low-1.png){#fig-repertoire-low-2 width=576} ::: ::: > As in the figure above, for class-level taxa with fewer than 50 habitat-associated KOs that carry at least 5 vent-only or vent-skewed KOs. Small repertoires make these fractions coarse: with 15 KOs, one KO moves a bar by about 7 percentage points. ### Figure S5 Combined ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} fig_repertoire + fig_repertoire_low + patchwork::plot_layout(ncol = 1, guides = "collect", heights = c(1, 0.5)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](05b-lineage-profiles_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-1-1.png){width=1440} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # ggsave("figures/supp-repertoire-panel.svg", width = 15, height = 20) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # >SKH: 2026-11-13 every lineage with habitat-associated KOs: repertoire size vs share # of KOs detected at vents (vent-only + vent-skewed + shared) LOW_N_BAND <- 15 scatter_labels <- c("Metamonada (unres.)", "Parablepharismea", "Anaeramoeba", "Dysnectes", "Spirotrichea", "Florideophyceae", "Euglenozoa") # Figure 4 lineages, bold # LABEL_MIN_KO <- MIN_REPERTOIRE # >SKH: 2026-11-23 also label every lineage with >= 50 KOs (the repertoire bar figure set) LABEL_MIN_KO <- Inf repertoire_scatter <- repertoire |> filter(n_ko > 0) |> mutate(frac_vent = (vent_only + vent_skewed + shared) / n_ko, lab = if_else(taxon %in% scatter_labels | n_ko >= LABEL_MIN_KO, taxon, NA_character_), lab_face = if_else(taxon %in% scatter_labels, "bold", "plain")) fig_repertoire_scatter <- ggplot(repertoire_scatter, aes(n_ko, frac_vent)) + annotate("rect", xmin = 0.8, xmax = LOW_N_BAND, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey85", alpha = 0.5) + geom_point(aes(fill = cur_group), size = 2, alpha = 0.85, shape = 21, color = "black") + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = lab, fontface = lab_face), size = 2.5, colour = "black", min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = 0.4, segment.colour = "grey50", max.overlaps = Inf, na.rm = TRUE, seed = 1) + scale_fill_manual(values = tax_color_metaT, breaks = intersect(SUPERGROUP_0_ordering, unique(repertoire_scatter$cur_group)), name = NULL) + scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) + labs(x = "Habitat-associated KOs per lineage (log10)", y = "Share vent-only, vent-skewed or shared", fill = NULL) + theme_classic(base_size = 11) + theme(text = element_text(colour = "black"), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), strip.background = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_line(color = "grey90", linetype = "dashed")) fig_repertoire_scatter ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](05b-lineage-profiles_files/figure-html/fig-repertoire-scatter-1.png){#fig-repertoire-scatter width=672} ::: ::: > Repertoire size and vent detection for every class-level taxon with habitat-associated KOs. Each point is one lineage; the y-axis is the share of its lineage-resolved KOs classed as vent-only, vent-skewed or shared. The grey band marks lineages with fewer than 15 KOs, where one KO shifts the share by about 7 percentage points or more. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # left = vent-only carriers, x = their occupancy across non-vent samples, # y = share of all vent-only KO expression at vents # right = non-vent-only carriers, x = their occupancy across vent samples, # y = share of all non-vent-only KO expression at non-vent samples # Definitions used in this chunk: # lineage = class-level taxon (cur_L4; label in `taxon`) # lineage-resolved KO = one lineage x KO pair (rows of pairs_assoc) # vent-only KO = lineage-resolved KO whose pair class (habitat_class, 05 occupancy rule) is # "vent_only": detected (>= MIN_TPM scaledTPM and >= MIN_PER_MILLION) in # >= MIN_UNITS[["vent"]] vent samples and in no background sample (plume allowed) # non-vent-only KO = >= MIN_UNITS[["nonvent"]] non-vent samples and in no vent sample # vent-only carrier = a lineage with at least one vent-only KO # non-vent-only carrier = a lineage with at least one non-vent-only KO # n_only = number of habitat-only KOs the lineage carries in that panel # tpm_only = summed TPM of those KOs across that habitat's samples # (tpm_vent over 13 vent samples; tpm_nonvent over 6 non-vent samples) # share_only = tpm_only / total habitat-only KO TPM over all carriers in that panel (sums to 1) # occ_other = fraction of the OTHER habitat's samples where the lineage is detected # (occ_nonvent in the left panel, occ_vent in the right panel) # taxon_habitat = the lineage's own habitat class from 05 (05_taxon_habitat.csv), same # occupancy rule applied to the lineage as a whole: # "shared" = lineage detected in >= 3 vent AND >= 3 non-vent samples # (MIN_UNITS); it does NOT mean present in every sample # "below_filter" = lineage misses MIN_UNITS in both habitats (NA after join) # shared_pct = per panel, share of habitat-only KO expression carried by "shared" lineages N_CARRIER_LABELS <- 8 # label the 8 largest carriers by share_only in each panel carrier_panels <- c(vent_only = "Vent-only KOs (expression at vents)", nonvent_only = "Non-vent-only KOs (expression at non-vent samples)") habitat_carriers <- bind_rows( pairs_assoc |> filter(habitat_class == "vent_only") |> summarise(n_only = n(), tpm_only = sum(tpm_vent), .by = cur_L4) |> mutate(panel = "vent_only"), pairs_assoc |> filter(habitat_class == "nonvent_only") |> summarise(n_only = n(), tpm_only = sum(tpm_nonvent), .by = cur_L4) |> mutate(panel = "nonvent_only")) |> mutate(share_only = tpm_only / sum(tpm_only), .by = panel) |> left_join(repertoire |> select(cur_L4, taxon, cur_group, taxon_habitat, occ_vent, occ_nonvent), by = "cur_L4") |> mutate(taxon_habitat = replace_na(taxon_habitat, "below_filter"), occ_other = if_else(panel == "vent_only", occ_nonvent, occ_vent), # >SKH: 2026-11-23 also label every lineage that is not 'shared' and the Figure 4 lineages (bold) lab = if_else(min_rank(desc(share_only)) <= N_CARRIER_LABELS | taxon_habitat != "shared" | taxon %in% scatter_labels, taxon, NA_character_), lab_face = if_else(taxon %in% scatter_labels, "bold", "plain"), .by = panel) |> mutate(panel = factor(panel, levels = names(carrier_panels), labels = carrier_panels)) carrier_summary <- habitat_carriers |> summarise(n_ko = sum(n_only), share = sum(share_only), n_taxa = n(), .by = c(panel, taxon_habitat)) |> mutate(frac_ko = n_ko / sum(n_ko), .by = panel) |> arrange(panel, desc(share)) carrier_summary ``` ::: {#fig-ventonly-carriers-1 .cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} shared_pct <- carrier_summary |> filter(taxon_habitat == "shared") |> select(panel, share) |> deframe() shared_pct_vent <- unname(shared_pct[carrier_panels[["vent_only"]]]) shared_pct_nonvent <- unname(shared_pct[carrier_panels[["nonvent_only"]]]) message(glue("Lineages present in both habitats (05 class 'shared') carry ", "{scales::percent(shared_pct_vent, 0.1)} of vent-only KO expression at vents and ", "{scales::percent(shared_pct_nonvent, 0.1)} of non-vent-only KO expression at non-vent samples")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Lineages present in both habitats (05 class 'shared') carry 96.8% of vent-only KO expression at vents and 99.3% of non-vent-only KO expression at non-vent samples ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # >SKH: 2026-11-23 one plot per panel so each gets its own size scale (option a, 2026-11-22): # facet_wrap shares one size scale, and vent-only carriers (max ~40 KOs) vs non-vent-only # (max >1,000) cannot both read on it. Fill key is shared so the class legend collects into one. carrier_fill_levels <- intersect(c(names(class_pal), "below_filter"), unique(habitat_carriers$taxon_habitat)) # >SKH: 2026-11-23 same y-axis range in both panels carrier_ylim <- range(habitat_carriers$share_only) # >SKH: 2026-11-23 labels sit in two aligned columns: points at >= 50% occupancy label to a # column right of the panel, points below 50% to a column on the left; ggrepel only moves them # up and down (direction = "y"), so the names line up. LABEL_COL_RIGHT <- 1.12 LABEL_COL_LEFT <- -0.12 plot_carriers <- function(panel_key, x_lab, size_breaks, size_name, shared_share) { d <- habitat_carriers |> filter(panel == carrier_panels[[panel_key]]) |> mutate(x_plot = occ_other + withr::with_seed(1, runif(n(), -0.02, 0.02))) # fixed jitter lab_right <- filter(d, !is.na(lab), occ_other >= 0.5) lab_left <- filter(d, !is.na(lab), occ_other < 0.5) repel_col <- \(df, x_col, hjust) ggrepel::geom_text_repel( data = df, aes(label = lab, fontface = lab_face), nudge_x = x_col - df$x_plot, hjust = hjust, direction = "y", size = 2.5, colour = "black", segment.colour = "grey60", segment.size = 0.3, min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = 0.15, force = 0.5, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 1) ggplot(d, aes(x_plot, share_only)) + geom_point(aes(fill = taxon_habitat, size = n_only), alpha = 0.85, shape = 21, color = "black", show.legend = TRUE) + # TRUE draws keys for classes absent from this panel repel_col(lab_right, LABEL_COL_RIGHT, 0) + repel_col(lab_left, LABEL_COL_LEFT, 1) + scale_fill_manual(values = c(class_pal, below_filter = "grey50"), limits = carrier_fill_levels, # same key in both panels -> one legend labels = \(x) c(class_lab, below_filter = "Below filter")[x], name = "Lineage habitat class") + scale_size(range = c(1.5, 10), trans = "sqrt", breaks = size_breaks, name = size_name) + # identical fill keys in both panels so patchwork collects them into one legend guides(fill = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(size = 3))) + scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25), minor_breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.125), limits = c(-0.5, 1.5)) + scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = carrier_ylim) + labs(title = str_wrap(carrier_panels[[panel_key]], 30), subtitle = paste0("Shared lineages carry ", scales::percent(shared_share, 0.1)), x = x_lab, y = "Share of habitat-only KO expression (log10)") + theme_classic(base_size = 11) + theme(text = element_text(colour = "black"), plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey30"), panel.grid = element_line(color = "grey90", linetype = "dashed")) } fig_ventonly_carriers <- plot_carriers("vent_only", "Lineage occupancy across non-vent samples", size_breaks = c(1, 10, 25, 40), size_name = "Vent-only KOs", shared_share = shared_pct_vent) + plot_carriers("nonvent_only", "Lineage occupancy across vent samples", size_breaks = c(10, 100, 500, 1000), size_name = "Non-vent-only KOs", shared_share = shared_pct_nonvent) + patchwork::plot_layout(nrow = 1, guides = "collect") fig_ventonly_carriers # ggsave("figures/05b-ventonly-carriers.svg", fig_ventonly_carriers, width = 13, height = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](05b-lineage-profiles_files/figure-html/fig-ventonly-carriers-1.png){#fig-ventonly-carriers-2 width=1248} ::: ::: > Lineages carrying habitat-only KO expression. Left: lineages with at least one vent-only lineage-resolved KO, plotted against their occupancy across non-vent samples; y is the lineage's share of all vent-only KO expression (summed TPM across vent samples). Right: the mirror for non-vent-only KOs, against occupancy across vent samples, with expression summed across non-vent samples. Point size is the number of habitat-only KOs; colour is the lineage's own habitat class from 05. Lineages present in both habitats (detected in at least 3 vent and 3 non-vent samples) carry 96.8% of vent-only and 99.3% of non-vent-only KO expression. ### Figure 4 ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ((fig_repertoire_scatter + plot_spacer())/ fig_ventonly_carriers) + patchwork::plot_layout(ncol = 1, widths = c(0.5, 1), guides = "collect") # ggsave("figures/05b-panel-shared-habitat-dist.svg", width = 12, height = 10) # ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](05b-lineage-profiles_files/figure-html/fig-together-1.png){#fig-together width=1152} ::: ::: ## Are vent-specific KOs carried by vent-specific taxa? Each pair is placed by the 05 class of its taxon and the class of the pair itself. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} taxon_by_pair <- pairs_assoc |> filter(!is.na(taxon_habitat)) |> count(taxon_habitat, habitat_class) |> mutate(frac_of_pair_class = n / sum(n), .by = habitat_class) taxon_by_pair |> select(-n) |> pivot_wider(names_from = taxon_habitat, values_from = frac_of_pair_class, values_fill = 0) |> mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 3))) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: > For results: for pairs in each class, the share carried by vent-only / vent-skewed / shared / non-vent taxa. If vent-only pairs sit mostly on shared taxa, vent specificity is the same lineages expressing different genes. If they sit on vent-only taxa, it is lineage turnover. # 2. Functional profile of each lineage (KEGG level B) Each lineage's expression is split across level-B categories **within each unit where it is detected** and averaged over those units (the 05 `kegg-leaders` rule). The reference is the habitat's whole-community composition on the same mapped-expression basis. `log2_enrich` > 0 means the lineage puts more of its expression into that category than the habitat does. A KO in *n* categories counts 1/*n* in each. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} kegg_long <- paired |> select(sample_unit, n_reps, vent_bin, field, cur_group, cur_L4, ko_id, scaledTPM) |> inner_join(brite_map |> select(ko_id, a_description, description, n_cat), by = "ko_id", relationship = "many-to-many") |> mutate(scaledTPM = scaledTPM / n_cat) # habitat reference composition (mapped expression) ref_comp <- unit_expression(kegg_long, "description") |> mutate(ref_share = tpm / sum(tpm), .by = unit) |> select(unit, vent_bin, description, ref_share) |> complete(nesting(unit, vent_bin), description, fill = list(ref_share = 0)) |> summarise(ref = mean(ref_share), .by = c(vent_bin, description)) # lineages that get a profile: associated with the habitat and a visible share of it profile_taxa <- bind_rows( tax_hab |> filter(n_det_vent >= MIN_UNITS[["vent"]], mean_share_vent >= MIN_PROFILE_SHARE) |> transmute(vent_bin = "Vent", cur_L4), tax_hab |> filter(n_det_nonvent >= MIN_UNITS[["nonvent"]], mean_share_nonvent >= MIN_PROFILE_SHARE) |> transmute(vent_bin = "Non-vent", cur_L4)) profile_taxa |> count(vent_bin) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} tax_unit <- unit_expression(paired, "cur_L4", min_tpm = MIN_TPM, min_per_million = MIN_PER_MILLION) detected_taxa <- tax_unit |> filter(detected) |> distinct(unit, cur_L4) taxon_kegg_unit <- unit_expression(kegg_long |> filter(cur_L4 %in% unique(profile_taxa$cur_L4)), c("cur_L4", "description")) |> mutate(taxon_share = tpm / sum(tpm), .by = c(unit, cur_L4)) |> semi_join(detected_taxa, by = c("unit", "cur_L4")) # every profiled lineage in BOTH habitats (the figure shows each lineage on both sides); # `profiled` marks the habitat(s) where it passed the profile rule lineage_profile_all <- taxon_kegg_unit |> select(unit, vent_bin, cur_L4, description, taxon_share) |> complete(nesting(unit, vent_bin, cur_L4), description, fill = list(taxon_share = 0)) |> summarise(mean_taxon_share = mean(taxon_share), n_units = n_distinct(unit), .by = c(vent_bin, cur_L4, description)) |> left_join(profile_taxa |> mutate(profiled = TRUE), by = c("vent_bin", "cur_L4")) |> mutate(profiled = coalesce(profiled, FALSE)) |> left_join(ref_comp, by = c("vent_bin", "description")) |> left_join(tax_key |> select(cur_L4, cur_group, taxon), by = "cur_L4") |> left_join(brite_map |> distinct(description, a_description), by = "description") |> mutate(log2_enrich = log2((mean_taxon_share + 0.001) / (ref + 0.001))) # tables and text use the profiled habitat(s) only lineage_profile <- lineage_profile_all |> filter(profiled) |> select(-profiled) # stopifnot(!anyNA(lineage_profile$taxon)) # for each lineage and habitat, the categories it is most over-invested in lineage_profile |> filter(mean_taxon_share >= 0.02) |> slice_max(log2_enrich, n = 3, by = c(vent_bin, cur_L4)) |> arrange(vent_bin, cur_group, taxon, desc(log2_enrich)) |> transmute(vent_bin, taxon, description, taxon_pct = round(100 * mean_taxon_share, 1), habitat_pct = round(100 * ref, 1), log2_enrich = round(log2_enrich, 2), n_units) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}

class-level lineage relative to its habitat. Rows are every lineage profiled in either habitat (associated with the habitat and holding at least 0.5% mean share there), shown in both panels so each lineage can be compared across habitats. The top row is the habitat's whole-community composition (% of mapped expression). Colour is log2 (the lineage's share of its own mapped expression / the habitat's share), clipped at +/-2: red, over-invested; blue, under-invested. Dark grey: lineage detected in the habitat but no expression in that category. Light grey: lineage not detected in any unit of the habitat. Cell numbers are the lineage's own percentage in the category (shown at 5% or more). Shares are averaged over the units where the lineage is detected; the number right of each row is that unit count (of 13 vent, 6 non-vent). Columns are all 21 categories, most expressed first. # 3. Same function, same lineage? KOs expressed in both habitats For KOs 05 calls **shared**, compare the sets of taxa that express them in the two habitats at class level and at supergroup level (Jaccard index of the taxon sets). A taxon is in a KO's set for a habitat when its pair is detected in ≥ `pair_min_units` units of that habitat. *Identical* = same taxa; *partial* = some overlap; *disjoint* = no taxon in common, so the function is expressed in both habitats by different lineages. KOs with a taxon in only one habitat cannot be compared and are counted separately. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} shared_kos <- ko_hab |> filter(habitat_class == "shared") |> pull(ko_id) # taxon x KO pairs detected in >= min_units units of one habitat pairs_in_habitat <- function(hab, min_units) { det_col <- if (hab == "vent") "n_det_vent" else "n_det_nonvent" pair_all |> filter(.data[[det_col]] >= min_units) |> transmute(ko_id, cur_L4, cur_supergroup, habitat = hab) } # one row per shared KO: how the taxon sets of the two habitats compare compare_taxon_sets <- function(min_units) { bind_rows(pairs_in_habitat("vent", min_units), pairs_in_habitat("nonvent", min_units)) |> filter(ko_id %in% shared_kos) |> summarise( n_L4_vent = n_distinct(cur_L4[habitat == "vent"]), n_L4_nonvent = n_distinct(cur_L4[habitat == "nonvent"]), n_L4_both = length(intersect(cur_L4[habitat == "vent"], cur_L4[habitat == "nonvent"])), n_L2_vent = n_distinct(cur_supergroup[habitat == "vent"]), n_L2_nonvent = n_distinct(cur_supergroup[habitat == "nonvent"]), n_L2_both = length(intersect(cur_supergroup[habitat == "vent"], cur_supergroup[habitat == "nonvent"])), .by = ko_id) |> mutate(jaccard_L4 = n_L4_both / (n_L4_vent + n_L4_nonvent - n_L4_both), jaccard_L2 = n_L2_both / (n_L2_vent + n_L2_nonvent - n_L2_both), comparable = n_L4_vent > 0 & n_L4_nonvent > 0, turnover_L4 = case_when(!comparable ~ "taxon in one habitat only", n_L4_both == 0 ~ "disjoint", jaccard_L4 == 1 ~ "identical", TRUE ~ "partial"), turnover_L2 = case_when(!comparable ~ "taxon in one habitat only", n_L2_both == 0 ~ "disjoint", jaccard_L2 == 1 ~ "identical", TRUE ~ "partial"), pair_min_units = min_units) } turnover <- compare_taxon_sets(PAIR_MIN_UNITS) # message(glue("{length(shared_kos)} shared KOs; {nrow(turnover)} have a taxon in at least one habitat")) ## Categories of distribution information. bind_rows(turnover |> count(rank = "class (L4)", turnover = turnover_L4), turnover |> count(rank = "supergroup (L2)", turnover = turnover_L2)) |> mutate(frac = round(n / sum(n), 3), .by = rank) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
